body: Jesse Mejía is a composer and educator living in Portland, Oregon. Jesse is lead designer at Parallel Studio, started the Creative Coding degree paths at Portland Community College, founded the Interactivity Lab, and the High Density Loudspeaker Array UnityGain. In addition to teaching interactive media in many forms, Jesse works with other artists, choreographers, musicians and engineers to collaboratively make interdisciplinary performances, immersive installations, and late night dance music, and leads CHOIR an experimental choir that re-frames contemporary choral music in new interdisciplinary contexts.
